dev.description: Run backend and frontend dev servers
dev.template: Start the development servers. Run `npm run dev --prefix backend` (Express + Nodemon) and `npm run dev --prefix frontend` (Vite) in parallel. Report the local URLs.

build.description: Install deps and build the project
build.template: Run `npm run build` from the project root to install backend/frontend deps and build the frontend.

start.template: Run `npm start` from the project root to start the Express backend.
